_comment: Sourced 19-product line. Prices = sheet retail (premium, adjustable). Images = 34 vetted clean supplier shots staged in /public/products. Products with <4 images import as Draft.

products.title: Autivara Solar — Spinning Car Diffuser
products.body_html:
A solar-driven rotor spins the moment sunlight hits your dash, fanning fragrance through the cabin with zero batteries, zero cords, and nothing to plug in or charge.

  • Solar-powered rotor — no batteries, no charging
  • Secure fit on any air vent
  • Waterless — just a few drops of oil, no spills
  • Refillable scent core you can top up anytime
products.seo_title: Autivara Solar | Solar-Powered Spinning Car Diffuser
products.seo_description: A solar-driven rotor spins the moment sunlight hits your dash, fanning fragrance through your cabin — no batteries, no cords, nothing to charge.

products.title: Autivara Astronaut — Car Vent Diffuser
products.body_html:
The finely sculpted astronaut that started the whole line — a display-worthy figure that clips to your vent and turns plain airflow into your signature scent.

  • Detailed collectible figure, offered in several colorways
  • Clips securely onto any air vent
  • Waterless core — a few drops of oil, no water tank, no spills
  • Refillable, so you can swap scents whenever the mood changes
products.seo_title: Autivara Astronaut | Sculpted Car Vent Diffuser
products.seo_description: The finely sculpted astronaut that started the line — a display-worthy figure that clips to your vent and turns airflow into your signature scent.

products.title: Autivara Aviator — Bear Propeller Diffuser
products.body_html:
A precision pilot bear car diffuser whose propeller actually spins on your vent's airflow — the moving part, not just a sculpt, is what fans scent evenly through the cabin.

  • Working propeller that spins on airflow
  • Soft-touch silicone clip fits any vent
  • Magnetic top lifts off for quick, mess-free refills
  • Waterless core — a few drops of oil, no spills
products.seo_description: A pilot bear car diffuser whose propeller actually spins on your vent's airflow, fanning scent through the cabin — with a magnetic top for mess-free refills.

products.title: Autivara Disc — Magnetic Vent Diffuser
products.body_html:
Machined from solid metal into a sleek two-piece disc that closes with a satisfying magnetic snap — the most understated, grown-up piece in the line.

  • Machined two-piece metal body — no plastic, no novelty shape
  • Magnetic snap top makes swapping the scent pad effortless
  • Clips securely onto any air vent
  • Waterless refillable felt pad — a few drops of oil, no spills, arrives gift-boxed
products.seo_title: Autivara Disc | Machined Metal Magnetic Vent Diffuser
products.seo_description: A machined solid-metal disc that closes with a satisfying magnetic snap — the most understated, grown-up diffuser in the Autivara car line.

products.title: Autivara Cabin — Rechargeable Car Diffuser
products.body_html:
The only Autivara car diffuser you power up rather than clip to a vent — a clean, minimal unit you place anywhere in the cabin and dial the scent up or down to taste.

  • USB-C rechargeable — no vent clip, no batteries to swap
  • Adjustable intensity you control
  • Waterless refillable core — a few drops of oil, no spills
  • Arrives gift-boxed
products.seo_title: Autivara Cabin | USB-C Rechargeable Car Diffuser
products.seo_description: A USB-C rechargeable car diffuser you place anywhere in the cabin, with adjustable output and a waterless refillable core — no vent clip needed.

products.title: Autivara Pulse — Smart Spray Car Diffuser
products.body_html:
The only Autivara that sprays on its own — a smart micro-mist puffs fragrance on a timer you set, with an ambient light ring that glows for night drives.

  • Programmable timed micro-spray — set it and forget it
  • Three intensity modes, from subtle to bold
  • Ambient light ring for night drives
  • USB-C rechargeable
products.seo_title: Autivara Pulse | Timed Smart-Spray Car Diffuser + Light
products.seo_description: A smart micro-spray car diffuser that mists fragrance on a timer you set, finished with an ambient light ring for night drives.

products.title: Autivara Ember — Volcano Flame Diffuser
products.body_html:
A sculptural volcano that erupts a glowing plume of cool mist — the drama of molten lava with none of the heat, equal parts diffuser and tabletop centerpiece.

  • Lava-glow lighting that makes the mist plume look like a rising eruption
  • Ultrasonic cool mist — runs cool to the touch, never hot
  • Auto shut-off the moment the tank runs dry
  • USB powered, so it plugs in anywhere
products.seo_title: Autivara Ember | Volcano Diffuser with Lava-Glow Mist
products.seo_description: A sculptural volcano that erupts a glowing plume of cool mist — the drama of molten lava with none of the heat, and none of the mess.

products.title: Autivara Nimbus — Jellyfish Mist Diffuser
products.body_html:
Backlit jellyfish drift and sway inside a column of cool mist — a living aquarium of light and scent you steer from the couch with the included remote.

  • Dynamic jellyfish light effect that shifts through color
  • Handheld remote to change the mood without getting up
  • Cool, whisper-quiet ultrasonic mist — never hot
  • Auto shut-off when the water runs dry
products.seo_title: Autivara Nimbus | Jellyfish Mist Diffuser with Remote
products.seo_description: Backlit jellyfish drift through a column of cool mist — a mesmerising light-and-scent piece you set the mood for with the included remote.

products.title: Autivara Hearth — Fireplace Flame Diffuser
products.body_html:
A miniature fireplace whose flickering flame looks convincingly real — all the cozy glow of a hearth, with cool mist instead of heat.

  • Strikingly realistic flame effect for a fireplace glow
  • Ultrasonic cool mist — never hot to the touch
  • Multiple timer modes to match your evening
  • Auto shut-off when the water runs dry
products.seo_title: Autivara Hearth | Fireplace Flame Diffuser (No Heat)
products.seo_description: A miniature fireplace with a strikingly realistic flickering flame and soft scented mist — the cozy glow of a hearth, without the heat.

products.title: Autivara Apollo — Rocket Flame Diffuser
products.body_html:
A poised desk rocket that appears to lift off on its own glowing plume of mist — a small statement piece for a workspace that could use a little liftoff.

  • Rocket-shaped build sized for a desk, shelf, or bookcase
  • Flame-glow lighting mimics an engine burn beneath the mist
  • Ultrasonic cool mist — quiet, never hot
  • USB powered, so it plugs straight into your laptop or desk hub
products.seo_title: Autivara Apollo | Rocket Flame Desk Diffuser (USB)
products.seo_description: A poised desk rocket that lifts off on a glowing plume of cool mist — a compact, USB-powered statement piece for your workspace.

products.title: Autivara Nova — Disco-Ball Light Diffuser
products.body_html:
A mirrored disco ball that scatters spinning light across the whole room while it diffuses — the diffuser that turns any gathering into a party.

  • Rotating mirror-ball light show
  • Multiple light modes to match the mood
  • Ultrasonic cool mist — no heat
  • USB powered
products.seo_title: Autivara Nova | Disco-Ball Light-Show Mist Diffuser
products.seo_description: A mirrored disco ball that scatters spinning light across the whole room while it diffuses cool scented mist — the centerpiece for any party.

products.title: Autivara Grove — Wood-Grain Diffuser
products.body_html:
A warm wood-grain column that reads more like a natural-material objet than a gadget — the diffuser for people who want scent without a flame effect or a light show stealing the room.

  • Wood-grain finish that blends into shelves, mantels, and nightstands
  • Ultrasonic cool mist — no heat, whisper-quiet
  • Soft ambient glow for gentle nighttime light
  • Auto shut-off when the tank runs dry
products.seo_title: Autivara Grove | Minimalist Wood-Grain Mist Diffuser
products.seo_description: A warm wood-grain column with a soft ambient glow — the understated diffuser for anyone who wants scent without a flame effect or a light show.

products.title: Autivara Express — Steam-Train Diffuser
products.body_html:
A finely detailed locomotive that puffs scented mist right out of its smokestack — a collectible display piece that actually works.

  • Scented mist rises from the stack like real steam
  • Cool ultrasonic mist — no heat
  • Finely detailed, collectible build
  • USB powered
products.seo_title: Autivara Express | Steam-Train Diffuser (Mist From the Stack)
products.seo_description: A finely detailed locomotive that puffs scented mist right out of its smokestack — a collectible display piece that actually works.

products.title: Autivara Reservoir — 4L Humidifying Diffuser
products.body_html:
The big-tank workhorse of the range — a 4-litre reservoir that humidifies and scents a whole room for hours before it needs another fill.

  • 4L large-capacity tank — far fewer refills than a novelty diffuser
  • Dial the mist up for a dry living room or down for an overnight bedroom setting
  • Top-fill design — just lift the lid and pour, no flipping the base
  • Timer and sleep modes to run it and forget it
products.seo_description: A 4-litre diffuser built to humidify and scent a whole room for hours between fills — adjustable mist, easy top-fill, timer and sleep modes.

products.title: Autivara Atmos Wi-Fi — Commercial Scent Diffuser
products.body_html:
A wall-mounted commercial diffuser you schedule from an app to cover a mid-size space with pure, waterless fragrance — no plumbing, no water tank, just oil misted straight into the air.

  • Wall-mounted for offices, lobbies, and mid-size showrooms
  • Set run times and strength from the Wi-Fi app
  • Waterless nebulizing sprays pure oil for a cleaner, stronger scent
  • Magnetic refill bay pops open for quick oil swaps
products.seo_title: Autivara Atmos Wi-Fi | App-Scheduled Commercial Diffuser
products.seo_description: A wall-mounted, app-scheduled commercial diffuser that fills a mid-size space with pure, waterless fragrance — controlled from your phone.

products.title: Autivara Atmos Pro — HVAC Scent Machine
products.body_html:
The flagship commercial diffuser of the line: instead of mounting on a wall, the Atmos Pro ties straight into your building's HVAC ductwork, so a single machine scents an entire venue evenly through the vents you already have.

  • Connects to your existing HVAC ducting for whole-building coverage
  • Set schedules and intensity to the minute from the app
  • Handles the largest commercial spaces — the top of the Atmos range
  • Waterless nebulizing spreads pure oil, no water or heat
products.seo_title: Autivara Atmos Pro | HVAC-Integrated Commercial Diffuser
products.seo_description: The flagship Atmos Pro commercial diffuser ties into your HVAC ductwork to scent an entire venue evenly through the vents you already have.

products.title: Autivara Plug — Smart Wall Diffuser
products.body_html:
The plug-and-go member of Autivara's commercial line — it slots straight into a wall outlet, no mounting or wiring, so a lobby, small office, or guest suite is scenting within minutes.

  • Direct wall-plug install — no mounting hardware
  • Wi-Fi app control for scheduling and intensity
  • Magnetic snap-in refill — swap oils in seconds
  • Discreet, low-profile footprint at the outlet
products.seo_title: Autivara Plug | Plug-In Wi-Fi Wall Scent Diffuser
products.seo_description: A plug-in, app-controlled wall diffuser for offices, lobbies, and suites — no mounting, no wiring, scenting within minutes.

products.title: Autivara Riff — Guitar Car Diffuser
products.body_html:
A finely formed guitar that sways on its 360° clip as air moves past it — a music-lover's detail that carries scent hands-free through the cabin.

  • Sways gently with the airflow for a bit of movement on the dash
  • 360° rotating silicone clip angles it however your vent sits
  • Waterless — a few drops of oil, no water and no spills
  • Refillable scent core fits any air vent
products.seo_title: Autivara Riff | Guitar Car Diffuser That Sways With Airflow
products.seo_description: A finely formed guitar that sways on its 360° clip as air moves past it — carrying scent hands-free through your cabin, no water and no spills.

products.title: Autivara Orchard — Pear Car Diffuser
products.body_html:
A softly sculpted pear that clips into your vent and quietly perfumes the cabin — no gimmick, no spinning parts, just a calm piece of fruit that happens to smell wonderful.

  • Sealed no-spill design — a few drops of oil, no leaks
  • Clips securely onto any air vent
  • Refillable waterless scent core
  • Compact and lightweight — barely bigger than the real thing
products.seo_title: Autivara Orchard | No-Spill Pear Vent Diffuser
products.seo_description: A softly sculpted pear that clips into your vent and quietly perfumes the cabin — sealed, no-spill, and refillable with a few drops of oil.
